PROVENANCE AND HONESTY NOTES — what was measured, what was inferred, what this drawing invented

MEASURED on the live server (qa/as-built-survey.md, RCON 2026-07-24): the Guest Center plate, height and materials; the street spine at y63 from z +200 to -235; water at y62 under the north stretch; nine home wall clusters at the z values labelled; grading to y~63.

INVENTED FOR DRAFTING, no source: every lot outline; the 9-block carriageway width; each home's 24x22 footprint box (only the street-facing edge, x ~ +/-20-25, was probed); the water band's lateral extent; the three unconfirmed lot positions; the portal-corridor widths.

FROM PLANNING DOCS ONLY, drawn dashed = NOT BUILT: parking field, frontage road, entrance drive, monument, event lawn, cooking school, warehouse, detention pond, cul-de-sac, greenbelt. Two rival pads exist for the monument, the cooking school and the warehouse - both are shown, neither is chosen

NO NAME IS PLACED ON A LOT. The 12-home roster is verified; the name-to-lot mapping was never recovered (REF-015) and the survey resolved only material families. Any pairing drawn here would be fabrication. Home count is still open at ~9 detected vs a verified 12 (DEF-003).

The four +/-285 portal approaches are RESERVED no-build (MSA OQ-7 / Raven Rock OQ-1). Note the west mouth N6 actually sits at x=-290, not -285. The RR-Z5 shaft head was RELOCATED to (200, 64, -15), x in [193,207] - outside MSA's footprint, so MSA's east flank is unconstrained by it.
Compass bearing is a build convention, not the real azimuth: the real parcel fronted I-45 on its WEST; this build fronts SOUTH (+Z). North = -Z is up on both sheets.

ODDITY, recorded not resolved: the surveyed y=63 placed surface runs continuously from z +200 to -235, i.e. straight THROUGH the Guest Center plate (z 90-180). Most likely one graded floor plane rather than a road through a building - unverified either way.
